name: kleosr
description: kleosr — Cursor harness pack (Master Mind V16). Rust kleos-gate only.

scripts.build: cargo build --release --manifest-path hooks/kleos-gate/Cargo.toml && mkdir -p hooks/bin && cp -f hooks/kleos-gate/target/release/kleos-gate hooks/bin/kleos-gate && chmod +x hooks/bin/kleos-gate
